comparison: Each subsampled VACF integral minus the dense0.25fs integral; no new diffusion estimate or literature test from this single replay.
memory_rule: Accumulate summed velocity FFT power in small component blocks; avoid a full time×molecule complex FFT workspace.
observable: Molecular COM velocity, float64; VACF trace integral divided by3 to2ps using all available origins. All cadence estimates are subsamples of the same dense trajectory.
replay: Restore the native binary checkpoint and external NumPy RNG; verify raw engine/canonical state; draw the one registered COM-projected Maxwell momentum; propagate the same native Verlet map for4ps.

selected_start_checkpoint.phase: end of preparation, before NVE segment-0 Maxwell refresh
selected_start_checkpoint.selection: Require exactly one committed checkpoint with state_step400000; verify its chunk, model, source and environment identities. Its checksum will be retained when it exists.

selection_rule: First registered NVE segment of the first registered chain, selected before any of its NVE data exists; no target-value selection.
